facts.fact: Xalam Analytics estimates about 45 live commercial (colocation) data centre facilities in South Africa in 2024, with about 390 MW live IT load, about 77% of supply carrier-neutral; no facility is named.
facts.system: Commercial colocation data centres, South Africa (unnamed)

facts.fact: Xalam states South Africa has public cloud regions: at least 2 in Cape Town and 4 in Johannesburg/Gauteng; the providers are not named.
facts.system: Public cloud regions, Cape Town and Gauteng (providers unnamed)

note: Reproduction-restricted study, figures paraphrased. Cloud region providers unnamed. No tier statements.
